name: DEPwD Post-Matric Scholarship for Students with Benchmark Disabilities
provider: Department of Empowerment of Persons with Disabilities (DEPwD), Ministry of Social Justice and Empowerment, Government of India
unchecked_criteria: Must have a benchmark disability of at least 40% under the RPwD Act 2016, with a valid disability certificate and UDID card or enrolment number
Indian nationals only; Aadhaar-based authentication is required
Not more than two children with disabilities of the same parents may receive benefits
Cannot receive another scholarship or stipend at the same time
Must be studying in Class XI or above (up to Master's level) in a recognized institution; distance and correspondence students are eligible
Employed students are eligible only if combined income with parents or guardian is within the limit
Certain courses are excluded (e.g. Aircraft Maintenance Engineer, Private Pilot Licence, some military or pre-exam training)
Scholarship for a class is available for only one year
benefit: Tuition and admission fee reimbursement up to Rs 1,40,000/year, miscellaneous compulsory fees up to Rs 10,000/year, maintenance allowance Rs 1,200/month (hosteller) or Rs 650/month (day scholar), disability allowance Rs 4,000/year (visual impairment or intellectual disability) or Rs 2,000/year (other), book allowance Rs 1,500/year. About 17,000 slots a year including renewals, 50% reserved for girls.
documents: Valid disability certificate issued by the competent authority
UDID card or UDID enrolment number
